clues.text: During King Herod's reign, they came from the east to Jerusalem after Jesus was born in Bethlehem.
In Jerusalem they asked where the newborn King of the Jews was, having seen His star.
King Herod sent them to Bethlehem to search for the Child and report back to him.
On the way to Bethlehem, a star went ahead of them and stopped over the Child's place.
Finding young Jesus with Mary, they bowed down and gave Him gold, frankincense and myrrh.
Warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they went home by another route.
Herod was furious at being outwitted by these visitors and killed Bethlehem's boys two and under.
